1.description: [Elune] [Shocking Rush] - now increases the damage dealt by Flametongue, Frostbrand and Windfury Weapon by 100% and its duration has been increased to 6 seconds.
[Elune] [Glacial Pact] Frozen Waters now increases the damage dealt by your Summoned Water Elemental by 250%.
[Elune] [Fiery Bash] - can now trigger when dealing damage with Shield Slam or Shield of Righteousness.
[Elune] [Echoing Power] - now causes your Echoing Fire to reduce your magic damage taken by 3%.
[Elune] [Echoing Power] - now causes your Frost Shock to also grant Echoing Frost reducing your damage taken by 2%.
[Elune] [Echoing Power] - now increases your threat with Shaman Shocks by 100%.
[Elune] [Frozen Flesh] - now grants 3% increased Frost Damage when you explode it with a Fire spell. Stacks up to 3.
[Elune] [Frozen Flesh] - now deals twice the base damage and scaling.
[Elune] [Tethered Power] - now also increases the critical strike damage bonus of Elemental Blast by 30%.
[Elune] [Eruption] - now also increases the damage of Flametongue Weapon by 30%, adding additional power to the Lava Lash toolkit of this talent.
[Area-52] [Elune] [Serpent Sting] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Serpent Sting by 5%.
[Area-52] [Elune] [Chimera Shot] - Now deals 230% ranged weapon damage, up from 210%.
[Area 52] Eldritch Knight has been temporarily disabled due to causing crashes.

[Pending Restart] - Callboard Caches on Elune can now drop Mythic0 Dungeon Gear.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Elune] Spell Reflect cast by NPCs now reflects damage up to a maximum of 30% of your total HP.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Elune] [Slave Pens] Naturalist Bite will now leave behind a 'Mark of Bite' allowing players to reapply the Mark of Bite buff to themselves if they die during the encounter.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Gruul's Lair] [Gruul the Dragonkiller]: Increased the starting cooldown of Cave In and Boulder to 30 seconds up from 24 and 28 Seconds.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes]: Infernals can no longer spawn on targets within the Sanguine Hall.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [High Commander Arynyes]: Corrected an issue where Imps may would keep spawning after Arynyes herself joined combat.

0.description: [Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Elune] [Warbringer O’mrogg] - No longer sprints towards his target once enraged, he now gains 5% movement speed every 10 seconds while enraged.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Elune] [Warp Splinter] - Sapling’s Broken Bark now increases the damage taken from by 75% from 40%.

[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Elune] [Omor the Unscarred] - Bane of Greed now has a different icon. This is because both debuffs shared the same spell icon and was confusing to who was affected by what debuff.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Elune] [Tavarok] - Tavarok’s Crystal Tomb in Mana Tombs can no longer target healers.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kil'jaeden]: Kil'jaeden can't cast Legion Lightning for the first 3 seconds after emerging from the Sunwell.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Brutallus]: Reduced the duration of Fel-fire Rain Fire Patches to 6 seconds down from 10.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Brutallus]: The tank targeting instance of Trample now has a 20 yard cone shape, changed from 12 yard radius circle.

7.description: [Area-52] [Forbidden Technique] - Fixed a bug causing the triggered Shadow Daggers and Dusk Daggers to be able to trigger other procs.

[Elune] [Forbidden Powers] - Updated the tooltip of Forbidden Powers to properly communicate that the launched Shadow Daggers are a 100% chance proc, it previously stated that you had a chance to launch them but did not specify how high the chance was.
[Elune] [Forbidden Powers] - Fixed a bug causing the triggered Shadow Daggers to be able to trigger other procs.
[Elune] [Forbidden Dance] - Fixed a bug causing the triggered Dusk Daggers to be able to trigger other procs.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [The Mechanar + The Arcatraz + The Blood Furnace]: The followind Mind Controlls now use the newest death proof version - Dominate Mind by Harbringer Skyriss, Dominate Mind by Pathaleon the Clculator, Brain Wash by The Maker.

1.description: [Pending Restart] The buff gained from Blessed Resilience has been changed and now reduces damage by 3/6/9%, changed from resilience based on Spirit.

0.description: [Elune] [Toxic Strikes] - Toxic Strikes now increase the damage of Deadly Throw by 6% per stack. Down from 10%.
[Elune] [Shadow of Death] - Shadow of Death now inherits 35% of the damage the Deadly Throw has dealt. Down from 75%.
[Elune] [Master of Kunai] Fixed a bug where on certain occasions you would not get the benefit of Master of Kunai on the target if there were multiple players using it.
[Elune] [Evoker] - Decreased the base damage and scaling of Sphere of Annihilation by 10%.
[Elune] [Evoker] - Evoker buff now increases the damage and crit chance of your mage spells by 2%. Down from 3%.
[Elune] [Fulmination] - Fulmination now reduces its damage by 30% for each jump. Up from 20%.
[Elune] [Charged Ice] - Charged Ice now increases the damage and critical strike damage bonus of Chain Lightning by 20%. Down from 35%.
[Elune] [Charged Ice] - Charged Ice now increases the damage and critical strike damage bonus of affected spells by 35%. Down from 45%.
[Elune] [Arctic Thunder] - Freezing Lightning now increases the damage and critical strike damage bonus of Astral Storm by 40%. Down from 60%.
[Elune] [Twilight Paragon] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Twilight Torment by 10%.
[Elune] [Twilight Torture] - Twilight Torture now has a new mechanic: Dealing damage with Twilight Torment increases the damage of Twilight Torture by 40%. Stacks 3 times.
[Elune] [Twilight Torture] - Twilight Torture now only loses 20% of the damage per jump. Down from 40%.
[Elune] [Twilight Torture] - Decreased the damage and scaling of Twilight Torture by 50%.
[Elune] [Atonement] - Dealing damage with Penance now converts 10% of the damage to healing down from 15%.
[Elune] [Atonement] - Atonement healing is capped at 30% of the casters maximum health.
[Elune] [Vampire Lord] - Vampiric Bond now lasts 12 sec from 10 sec.
[Elune] [Vampire Lord] - Vampire Lord healing is now increased by 50% when it heals you.
[Elune] [Vampire Lord] - Vampire Lord now caps the damage to healing conversion up to 5% of targets maximum health. This value will further scale with your Healing Power.
[Elune] [Twilight] - Fixed a bug where Twilight could surpass the Vampiric Embrace healing cap.
[Elune] [Vampiric Embrace] - The Party Heal from Vampiric Embrace can now heal up to 3% of the caster’s maximum health from 5%. The self heal remains unchanged.
[Elune] [Area-52] [Living Lightning] - Now reduces the healing by 25% on each chain, from 30%.
[Elune] [Area-52] - Fixed the tooltip issue of Chain Heal spells to reflect that they reduce the healing on each jump by 25% not 40%.

This change happened some time ago. Tooltips were just not reflecting correctly how much Chain Heal, Living Lighting, and Blessed Waves are reducing healing on each jump. Living Lightning was the only Chain Heal classed heal left with a 30% healing reduction. We are buffing it to have the same healing reduction as other spells for consistency.
[Elune] [Vessel of Destruction] - now increases the Fire and Shadow damage taken from the caster by 4% against monsters, down from 5%.
[Elune] [Felblade] - now deals 330% weapon damage, down from 350%.
[Elune] [Annihilan Decimation] - Annihilan Combo now increases the damage of Annihilan Decimation by 150%, down from 175%.
[Elune] [Will of Pa'ku] - A new talent for the Zandalari Archetype has been introduced.
[Elune] [Grove Shot] - Grove Shot can now trigger Overflow.
[Elune] [Loa’s Assault] - Reduced the Gonk drop radius. Shards of Gonk will now drop 20% closer to the player.
[Elune] [Blooming Shot] - Nature's Power now increases the damage and healing of your next Blooming Shot by 400%. Up from 200%.
[Elune] [Blooming Shot] - Decreased the base damage and scaling of Blooming Shot by 50%.
[Elune] [Explosive Eruption] - Explosive Eruption now increases the damage of your next Lava Lash by 65%. Up from 30%.
[Elune] [Demonic Influence] - Demonic Influence now increases the damage of your Summoned Imp and Wild Imps by 35%. Down from 50/40% respectively.
[Elune] [Entropy] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Entropy by 25%.
[Elune] [Agonizing Coil] - Increased the proc chance of Agonizing Coil from 15% to 18%.
[Elune] [Shocking Start] - Shocking Start now respects and triggers the cooldown for Eclipse (Solar).
[Elune] [Shadow Blades] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Shadow Blades by 20%.
[Elune] [Hail of Arrows] - Increased the ranged weapon damage of Hail of Arrows to 175%. Up from 150%.

[Elune] [Molten Ammo] - Fixed a bug causing Molten Ammo triggered through Aimed Shots to double dip on modifiers. The inherited damage of Molten Ammo triggered through Aimed Shot has been increased from 25% to 40%.
[Elune] [Necromancer's Touch] - Necromancer's Touch now increases the damage the target takes from your Drain Life by 32% per stack. Up from 30%.
[Elune] [Shadow Arrow] - Shadow Arrow damage over time now lasts 18 seconds(Same as Corruption). It now has the same scaling as Corruption.
[Elune] [Dark Intent] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Dark Intent by 10%.
[Elune] [Greater Judgement of Righteousness] - Fixed a bug causing some priest spells to not properly consume charges of Greater Judgement of Righteousness.
[Elune] [Rupturing Void] - Rupturing Void now makes your Rupture tick 35% more often, Up from 25%.
[Elune] [Rising Chaos] - Rising Chaos now increases the damage of Pure Chaos Bolt by 30% per stack, down from 45%.
[Elune] [Chaos Burn] - Decreased the base damage and scaling of Chaos Burn damage over time by 20%.
[Elune] [Heavyweight] - Heavyweight now increases the physical damage done by 1% per stack. Down from 2%.
[Elune] [Spell Shredder] - Increased the base damage of Elemental Shredder by 500% and its scaling by 30%. Elemental Rends have been reduced by 30% in PvP combat.
[Elune] [Fire Watch] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Fire Watch proc by 50%.
[Elune] [Exploding Storm] - Exploding Storm now increases the damage of your Immolation Trap by 70% and Explosive Trap by 40% per stack. Up from 50/18% respectively.
